nodes.label: Graphify 0.9.12 Pinned Internals
nodes.rationale: exact pin graphifyy==0.9.12; each listed internal must be re-verified before any version bump because the toolkit depends on undocumented behavior

nodes.label: build_merge Replace-on-Re-extract
nodes.rationale: all base-graph nodes/edges whose source_file matches any incoming file are dropped before merge; this is why route edges use the synthetic graph-tools/route-links source; build_merge also does not persist to disk despite its docstring, callers must to_json

nodes.label: Graphify Ignore fnmatch Semantics
nodes.rationale: python fnmatch so * crosses /; unanchored patterns match every path component at every depth, which is why all entries are root-anchored; detect merges the scan root's .gitignore, so the unanchored !cipp negation is load-bearing; nested ignore files are never read from a parent scan root

nodes.label: to_json Shrink Guard
nodes.rationale: to_json returns False writing nothing when the new graph has fewer nodes than the existing file unless force=True; update.py wraps it with its own 10 percent threshold + force=True, routelink/recluster use force=False deliberately
